etf.name: iShares Gold Trust
etf._btcPerShareNote: TROY OUNCES of gold per IAU share (physical ratio, declines as the 0.25% fee accrues). ~0.01868 is an ESTIMATE cross-checked from price/spot and public net-assets/shares, which only agree to ~1% -- reconcile against the iShares daily 'ounces of gold per share'. Do NOT recompute from IAU mid/spot (that forces NAV=mid, zeroes the basis).

market._btcSpotUsdNote: Dry-run seed only; the live gold feed overrides it. Kept near gold spot so --dry-run produces realistic IAU levels.

_dataGapNote: IAU pulls gold + the IAU quote from Yahoo Finance (via the allorigins CORS proxy) because neither is on the shared bitcoin market-overview feed. KNOWN GAP: the only gold price Yahoo serves cleanly is GC=F (COMEX front-month FUTURES), which trades ~1-2% above the LBMA spot IAU's NAV is struck on. So the displayed basis carries a structural futures-vs-spot offset (order tens of bps) and is NOT a trustworthy arbitrage signal. Durable fix: add IAU + an LBMA/XAU spot price to the backend market-overview API (same source ARKB/IBIT use), then IAU becomes a clean drop-in.

costs._creationRedemptionFeeNote: PLACEHOLDER ($500, same as ARKB). IAU's Authorized-Participant basket transaction fee is not publicly disclosed and could not be confirmed (SEC/iShares block scraping). Confirm from the prospectus and override. It dominates the cost model, so revisit before trusting any signal.
